content.comment_body: Does anyone know the monthly or yearly cost when subscribing to a 'free' AWS account for use with [product_name] [version_no]? The information available on the AWS website at [url] isn't very clear. Costs depend on what data from the [product_name] switching program will be synced with the cloud, whether cyclically or upon value changes (referencing Fig 3-9, Page 18 of [document]). I've attached a spreadsheet for calculating IO message costs to the cloud. For example, sending 1 message of 5 kB per minute from [product_name] to an MQTT server amounts to USD 56/month. Each HTTP lookup also adds cost. I haven't found a European pricing calculator yet. As for required services like AWS IAM and 'Elastic Beanstalk,' I’m unable to assess their costs. Keep in mind, the '1 year free' offer can lead to unexpectedly high bills afterward. What percentage does [company_name] collect?

Hello [user_name], I recommend reaching out to AWS directly for these questions via [url]. Sorry I can't provide a definitive answer – contacting the AWS team is likely your best option. Best regards, [user_name].
I won't be contacting Amazon/AWS; instead, I'm setting up my own MQTT broker on a PI for €56 for lifetime access. I feel bad for those unaware who get drawn in by the 'free' AWS offer.
Your approach is in your hands. It seems you may have misunderstood [user_name]'s previous comment.

Prices reference UK pounds in 2022. You're correct that the cloud service offered for [product_name] is lacking. We took on a project using [product_name], and when the client heard about remote cloud access, we agreed to try it. The process was complex; we had to find workarounds for device creation bugs and manage the free tiers in the first year. We bought an E2C instance (I'm unsure why [company_name] and AWS can't offer a tailored package for [product_name] so we wouldn't need to sort out savings plans ourselves). The E2C reduced our costs from roughly £45/month down to £20/month. We're hosting two [product_name] devices on a webpage via AWS, nothing advanced. Sending too many daily messages increased costs. For projects like this, I suggest organizing all data sent to AWS, using function blocks, and adding a 'go live' button so data is sent only when needed and changes are tagged, reducing message volume and costs. We initially agreed to host for 12 months, but after the client extended it indefinitely, monthly costs rose to £50, which we pass on. Purchasing another E2C instance didn't significantly lower costs. In hindsight, I’d have chosen a VPN like an eWon device, paired with a display panel and used Sm@rtclient; that would eliminate monthly bills and offer better platform control. So, connecting [product_name] with analog and digital data sent to AWS and minimal web viewing runs about £25/month, with usage increasing costs.

Thanks to everyone for sharing – this is an informative discussion. I'm continuing development on my solution now that [product_name] integrates better with remote platforms. Previously, I relied on VPN and direct access, but I’ve encountered problems with the custom webpage and still lack proper logging. Using the latest [version_no] and beginning AWS setup, it looks like the upcoming [version_no] might offer more flexibility and possibly won’t be restricted to AWS alone. The level of monthly costs discussed here is really my target for a yearly sum rather than monthly charges, as I can't pass such costs to my clients.
Thank you! I noticed your original post when the new units were announced with additional features. For me, this is the mature product we've been waiting for.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users encounter challenges and frustration with unpredictable and unclear costs of using [product_name] [version_no] in combination with AWS cloud services. The process is described as complex, with insufficient cost transparency and guidance from both [company_name] and AWS. There is dissatisfaction regarding native cloud integration features, unclear responsibilities for pricing, and the need for complex workarounds. Some participants suggest using alternative methods to avoid ongoing, high cloud service fees and the limitations of existing connectivity options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, reliable, and transparent information about the costs of connecting [product_name] [version_no] to AWS. They desire a straightforward way to estimate and manage cloud expenses when using [company_name] hardware for remote monitoring. Ideally, they would like targeted calculators, better documentation, and practical guidance from [company_name] to facilitate easier and more cost-effective integration.
